equation_summary: sigma_ij = (q_i·k_j)/sqrt(dk) with causal (-inf above diagonal) and optional sliding-window band mask. Per-head length temperature t_i = 1 + softplus(len_gain)·log(n_i) and null logit nu_i = null_base + softplus(null_slope)·sqrt(log(n_i+1)), n_i = causal key count (capped at window). Weights w = softmax over [t·sigma_real, t·nu] with the null sink as one extra logit column; masked entries neutralized to 0 BEFORE the temperature product, then re-set to -inf. Direction c = normalize(w_r·V + w_null·v_null, p=2, eps=1e-6) (unit vector; null sink contributes v_null, not zero). Magnitude mag = tanh(softplus(mag_beta)·log1p(n_eff·(1-w_null))) with participation ratio n_eff = 1/sum(w_hat^2), w_hat = w_r/sum(w_r). Output y = proj(c * sigmoid(gate)) + mu_proj(mag).
state_shape: none (materialized [B,H,Tq,Tk] reduction; KV cache at decode). Online kernel uses streamed accumulators (M,L,Q2,S)
gate_scope: per-head static learned params (len_gain, null_base, null_slope, mag_beta; sigmoid output gate per channel) — not data-dependent decay
normalization: softmax over keys + 1 null-sink logit, then L2-normalized direction and tanh-bounded count channel
ledger_verdicts: CONFIRM call graph `E[QKV/canonical convolution] ; B[K1 polar direction/count reducer] ; E[output gate/projections]`: reference.py PolarAttention.forward does exactly QKV projections + qk rms_norm + residual Canon causal conv1d on q/k/v (E), then polar_reduce (the blocked non-softmax-algebra reducer), then proj(c*sigmoid(gate)) + mu_proj(mag) (E).
